def run_restart(log) -> None:
    cmd = [hermes_bin(), "-p", "default", "gateway", "restart"]
    log("restart", f"running {shlex.join(cmd)} (CLI wait budget bounded; Hermes owns interruption and resume_pending)")
    # Do NOT add --force here: on `gateway restart` it means "start a separate gateway", not "override a guard".
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                           env=dict(os.environ, GATEWAY_COORDINATED_RESTART='1', HERMES_RESTART_AFTER_TURN_TIMEOUT='1', HERMES_RESTART_DRAIN_TIMEOUT='1'))
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        raise Fail(f"`hermes gateway restart` ran longer than {RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s. State: gateway may be down or "
                   f"still draining; drain marker will be cleared. Fix: `hermes -p default gateway status`, then "
                   f"`python3 {SCRIPT} request --reason \"retry\"`.")
    tail = (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-6:]
    for line in tail:
        log("restart", f"hermes: {line}")
    if r.returncode != 0 and "Restart budget blocked" in (r.stdout + r.stderr) and \
            bool(((load_state() or {}).get("request") or {}).get("force")):
        # 7 Oct 2026: Hermes allows one intentional restart per hour. This request was made with --force and the
        # gateway is already drained and idle, so restart through the service manager (what `hermes update` does).
        # Without this, an urgent rollback within the hour is blocked.
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            svc = [["launchctl", "kickstart", "-k", f"gui/{os.getuid()}/ai.hermes.gateway"]]
        else:
            svc = [["systemctl", "--user", "reset-failed", "hermes-gateway.service"],
                   ["systemctl", "--user", "restart", "hermes-gateway.service"]]
        for c in svc:
            log("restart", f"Hermes restart budget is spent and this request is --force: running {shlex.join(c)}")
            r = subprocess.run(c, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        for line in (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-4:]:
            log("restart", f"service manager: {line}")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        guard = ("  TurnerBook has a local guard that refuses a second restart within 60 minutes unless hermes is given "
                 "--force; wait it out (do not use --force here: on this command it starts a SEPARATE gateway). "
                 if sys.platform == "darwin" else "")
        raise Fail(f"`hermes gateway restart` exited {r.returncode}.{guard} State: gateway is whatever hermes left it "
                   f"(check `hermes -p default gateway status`); drain marker cleared so bots can work. Fix: read the "
                   f"hermes lines above, fix, then `python3 {SCRIPT} request --reason \"retry after failed restart\"`.")

log("pause", "would acquire owned ESTOP and every board dispatch lock; existing pause aborts safely")
    else:
        pause.acquire()
        # Publish before lock acquisition so a slow in-flight tick consumes the deadline.
        req["deadline_minutes"], req["deadline_at"] = publish_initial_deadline(rid, req["deadline_minutes"])
        pause.barrier(req["deadline_at"])

    # (a) drain marker
    foreign = read_marker()
    owns_marker = True
    if foreign and not str(foreign.get("principal", "")).startswith("coordinated-restart:"):
        owns_marker = False
        log("drain", f"a drain marker from {foreign.get('principal')!r} already exists; leaving it alone (we will not "
                     f"clear it). Remove it with: rm {DRAIN_MARKER}", loud=True)
    elif dry:
        log("drain", f"would write {DRAIN_MARKER}: {json.dumps(drain_marker_payload(principal, boot_epoch()))}")
    else:
        write_marker(principal)
        log("drain", f"wrote {DRAIN_MARKER}; gateway now refuses NEW turns, running turns continue")

key = None if dry else api_key()
        notified = notified_profiles(work)  # kept for step (j); see notified_profiles

        if dry:
            deadline_at = now() + req["deadline_minutes"] * 60
        else:   # one critical section: a joiner's shorter minutes cannot fall between the read and the write
            deadline_at = req["deadline_at"]
        req["deadline_at"] = deadline_at

        if is_idle(work):
            # (c)
            log("idle", "nobody is working: going straight to the restart")
        else:
            # (d)
            log("evaluate", restart_wait_guidance(), loud=True)
            send_notices(work, req, gs, key, log, dry)

st["request"]["status"] = "restarting"
            save_state(st)
        snap = collect_snapshot(False, lambda *a, **k: None)
        gs = snap["gateway_state"] or {}
        pre = {"pid": gateway_pid(gs), "served": gs.get("served_profiles") or [],
               "platforms": [p for p, v in (gs.get("platforms") or {}).items() if v.get("state") == "connected"]}
        interrupted, cards = cut_sets(who_is_working(snap))
        stragglers = describe_work(who_is_working(snap))
        with locked(STATE_LOCK):
            st = load_state()
            st["last_restart_at"] = now()
            save_state(st)
        pause.check()
        # Last fresh read, including workers finishing after their card was closed.
        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
        run_restart(log)

        # (h) clear marker immediately (it survives a gateway-only restart)
        if owns_marker:
            clear_own_marker(principal)
            log("drain", "drain marker cleared")
            owns_marker = False

        # (i) verify
        update_request(rid, status="verifying")
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)

log("resume", f"{p}: card {tid} -> {kanban_comment(tid, text)}")
        if interrupted:
            log("resume", "interrupted chat sessions are also resumed by Hermes itself (resume_pending); a bot that "
                          "checkpointed reads its Session-notes entry per the gateway-restart-checkpoint skill")
        wake_bots(wake_profiles(interrupted, cards, notified), req, wake_cmd, log, False)

        # (k) outcome
        status = "done" if ok and not stragglers else "done_with_warnings"
        outcome = (f"Restart {rid} finished {iso()}: gateway " + ("healthy." if ok else "NOT fully healthy: " +
                   "; ".join(problems) + f". Fix: hermes -p default gateway status; logs in {HERMES_HOME}/logs/.") +
                   (" Interrupted while working: " + " | ".join(stragglers) if stragglers else " Nobody was cut off."))
        update_request(rid, status=status, outcome=outcome, step="finished")
        atomic_write(OUTCOME_FILE, outcome + "\n")
        log("outcome", outcome, loud=not ok or bool(stragglers))
        if req.get("notify_cmd"):
            try:
                r = subprocess.run([*shlex.split(req["notify_cmd"]), outcome], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                log("outcome", f"sent to requester via notify-cmd (exit {r.returncode})")
            except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
                log("outcome", f"notify-cmd failed ({e}); the outcome is in {OUTCOME_FILE}", loud=True)
        else:
            log("outcome", f"no --notify-cmd route; requester reads it with `status` or {OUTCOME_FILE}")
    finally:

check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        update_request(rid, status='restarting', switch_cmd=req.get('switch_cmd'))
        run_retained_callback(req, log)
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        pause.check()
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
        gs = read_gateway_state() or {}
        pre = {'pid': gateway_pid(gs), 'served': gs.get('served_profiles') or [],
               'platforms': [p for p, v in (gs.get('platforms') or {}).items() if v.get('state') == 'connected']}
        run_restart(log)
        update_request(rid, status='verifying')
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)
        if not ok:
            raise Fail('Gateway health failed; pause retained: ' + '; '.join(problems))
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        update_request(rid, status='done', health_ok=True, outcome='Healthy. All pauses retained until explicit release.')

def common(sp, needs_reason):
        sp.add_argument("--reason", required=needs_reason, help="why a restart is needed (recorded and shown in status)")
        sp.add_argument("--by", help="who is asking (default: $HERMES_PROFILE, else $USER)")
        sp.add_argument("--deadline-minutes", type=float, default=DEFAULT_DEADLINE_MINUTES,
                        help=f"how long working bots get to checkpoint (default {DEFAULT_DEADLINE_MINUTES})")
        sp.add_argument("--min-gap-minutes", type=float, default=MIN_GAP_MINUTES,
                        help=f"minimum time between restarts (default {MIN_GAP_MINUTES})")
        sp.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="skip the minimum gap (needs --reason; it is recorded)")
        sp.add_argument("--notify-cmd", help="command that sends the outcome to the requester; the outcome text is "
                                             "appended as its last argument, e.g. \"hermes peer dm local/max-cndr\"")
        sp.add_argument("--wake-cmd", help="command that wakes one bot after the restart (default: hermes -p <bot> chat "
                                           "--in ~ -c \"Bot Chat\" --create-if-missing -Q -q <text>). {profile} and "
                                           "{text} are filled in; with no {text} the text is added as the last argument. "
                                           "Run once per cut bot, 60 s at most each. \"none\" turns it off")
        sp.add_argument("--switch-cmd", help="command run once after the gateway is idle and before it restarts, e.g. to switch "
                                             "the Hermes checkout (`git -C <checkout> checkout -B <branch> <ref>`). Split "
                                             "like --notify-cmd, no shell; 600 s limit; make it safe to run twice. A "
                                             "non-zero exit stops the restart (status failed, step FAILED: switch-cmd)")
        sp.add_argument("--retain-pause", action="store_true", help="retain all pauses until explicit successful release")
        sp.add_argument("--resume-request", help="recover this exact retained request after its processes exit")
        sp.add_argument("--switch-timeout", type=float, default=600, help="callback budget in seconds; must exceed the sum of recipe budgets")
        sp.add_argument("--auxiliary-plan", help="service fence plan JSON; defaults to state directory auxiliary-plan.json")
        sp.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="do every read, print what would happen, change nothing")

# `start`/`restart` on a named profile refuse while the default multiplexer serves it (a second gateway
# would double-bind its platforms); `gateway run` carries its own broader --force text.
_FORCE_SERVED_PROFILE_HELP = (
    "Start a separate gateway for this profile even when the default multiplexer already serves it "
    "(not recommended: two pollers on one bot token, port conflicts)")

# `stop`/`restart` ask before interrupting live turns, cron jobs or background delegations.
_INTERRUPT_HELP = (
    "{verb} without asking even while sessions are live (turns, cron jobs, background delegations): "
    "they are interrupted. Without it the command names the live work and asks y/N (refuses when "
    "there is no terminal). --interrupt is the same flag")

gateway_stop = gateway_subparsers.add_parser("stop", help="Stop gateway service")
    _add_system_flag(gateway_stop)
    _flag(gateway_stop, "--all", help="Stop ALL gateway processes across all profiles")
    _flag(gateway_stop, "-y", "--yes", "--interrupt", dest="interrupt", help=_INTERRUPT_HELP.format(verb="stop"))

    gateway_restart = gateway_subparsers.add_parser("restart", help="Restart gateway service")
    _add_system_flag(gateway_restart)
    _flag(gateway_restart, "--all",
        help="Kill ALL gateway processes across all profiles before restarting")
    _flag(gateway_restart, "--force", help=_FORCE_SERVED_PROFILE_HELP)
    _flag(gateway_restart, "-y", "--yes", "--interrupt", dest="interrupt", help=_INTERRUPT_HELP.format(verb="restart"))
    _flag(gateway_restart, "--detach", help=(
        "Without an installed service, start the replacement in the background (as `gateway ensure` "
        "does) instead of in this terminal; used by apps that run the restart as a short-lived client"))
    _add_compat_platform_flag(gateway_restart)

def _cmd_restart(args):
    _refuse_from_inside_gateway("restart", "restart loops")
    from hermes_cli.gateway_profile_lifecycle import profile_lifecycle
    if profile_lifecycle("restart", args):
        return
    system = getattr(args, "system", False)
    restart_all = getattr(args, "all", False)
    force = getattr(args, "force", False)
    # `--all` targets the ONE host multiplexer and _restart_all does its own ownership check with
    # the right one-liner; running the generic named-profile guard first made that branch
    # unreachable for `-p X gateway restart --all` (it printed a bare `gateway restart` instead).
    if not restart_all:
        _guard_named_profile_under_multiplexer(force=force)
    from hermes_cli.gateway_lifecycle_guards import refuse_while_sessions_live
    refuse_while_sessions_live("restart", args)
    if restart_all and _dispatch_all_via_service_manager_if_s6("restart"):
        return
    if not restart_all and _dispatch_via_service_manager_if_s6("restart"):

# Load .env from ~/.hermes/.env first, then project root as dev fallback.
# User-managed env files should override stale shell exports on restart.
from hermes_cli.config import get_hermes_home
from hermes_cli.env_loader import load_hermes_dotenv

# ``update`` must not resolve external secret sources (Windows self-lock via cryptography, slow
# helpers inside the import probe) — ``_early_recovery._should_skip_external_secret_sources``
# owns that argv check for every dotenv load in the process. See #73381.
load_hermes_dotenv(project_env=PROJECT_ROOT / ".env")

def _should_skip_external_secret_sources() -> bool:
    """True inside any ``hermes update`` process (and its import probes).

    Every dotenv load in the process — ``hermes_cli.main``, ``run_agent``, ``cli`` — consults
    this, so the updater never resolves external secret sources: on Windows they map
    ``cryptography._rust.pyd`` into the process replacing that venv, and everywhere a slow
    ``op``/``bws``/command helper (up to 120s per source) would run inside the updater's
    120s critical-module import probe and be reported as an import-health timeout.
    Profile flags are stripped before ``hermes_cli.main`` loads dotenv, so ``argv[1]`` is
    the authoritative subcommand.
    """
    return _UPDATE_RETRY_RECOVERED or sys.argv[1:2] == ["update"]
